recognize_zh: 骨髓中大量大型單核球系母細胞，胞質豐富灰藍、含細小空泡，部分細胞吞噬紅血球（erythrophagocytosis，D 格中央），細胞化學染色支持單核球分化，核型圖箭頭指向 8 號與 16 號染色體，符合 t(8;16) KAT6A 重組 AML。
features: Panel A: peripheral blood with a circulating large blast and a neutrophil
Panels B-D: marrow sheets of large monocytoid blasts with round to folded nuclei, fine chromatin and abundant gray-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Panel D: blast containing an engulfed red cell (erythrophagocytosis)
Panels E-F: cytochemical stains with granular cytoplasmic reactivity in blasts, supporting monocytic/myelomonocytic lineage
Panel G: G-banded karyotype with arrows on chromosomes 8 and 16 indicating t(8;16)(p11;p13)
describe_en: Peripheral blood (A) shows a circulating blast. Bone marrow aspirate (B-D) is replaced by large monocytoid blasts with round to indented nuclei, fine chromatin and abundant gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm; occasional blasts contain phagocytosed erythrocytes. Cytochemical stains (E-F) show granular cytoplasmic positivity in the blasts, consistent with monocytic or myelomonocytic differentiation. The karyotype (G) shows a translocation involving chromosomes 8 and 16. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with t(8;16)(p11.2;p13.3); KAT6A::CREBBP, in which blast erythrophagocytosis is a morphologic clue.

ddx.dx: Acute monocytic leukemia with KMT2A rearrangement
ddx.vs: Shows similar monoblasts but lacks prominent erythrophagocytosis and has an 11q23 rearrangement rather than t(8;16).
Hemophagocytes are mature benign histiocytes without a background of increased blasts.
Features abnormal eosinophils with large basophilic granules and a CBFB::MYH11 fusion.
Bilobed or heavily granulated promyelocytes with Auer rod bundles and t(15;17), not monocytoid vacuolated blasts.
